title: Homework: Refetch Once
objective: Serve token kids from a cached key set, refetch once when a kid is unknown, refuse a kid the refetch still does not contain, and count the refetches.
expected:
request 1: rsa-2026-01 from cache
request 2: rsa-2026-02 after refetch
request 3: refused, rsa-2026-03 not published
request 4: rsa-2026-02 from cache
fetches: 2
